  • [Pleasant Sound] - Finely-tuned by unique sound effect algorithm and precisely processed through multi frequency and strengthed bass to deliver powerful sound to please your ears. The 4W 40mm large driver makes human voice details deeper and richer.
  • [Enhanced Joy] - Equipped with Bluetooth 5.0 to have wide compatibility and build connection with most mainstream Bluetooth-enabled devices instantly and effectively with low distortion. The microphone inside allows you to talk freely and have conference meetings as well.
  • [Stereo Mode] - Supporting connecting two speakers to the same device, the wireless speakers stream combined stereo sound to bring the fantastic concertlike experience to you lying on the sofa and let the immersive sound light up your idle time.
  • [Heavy Rotation] - Built-in rechargeable Li-ion battery supports up to 8 hours playtime to make your day with the 360 surround sound that spreads the beautiful melody to every corner of your room, and to be your intimate companion outside anywhere anytime.
  • [Exquisite Workmanship] - Durable braiding craft and 3-color RGB light enrich the details of the speaker and optimize your enjoyment. The attached strip along with the portable design allow you to take the speaker ourdoors for hiking, cycling, picnic, etc.

SoundPEATS Halo Bluetooth Speaker

Dancing with the Visible Notes

With repeatedly tuning and comparison, SoundPEATS come up with this Halo speaker to fulfill all your expectation and requirement after a while since the last generation speaker ended. The outstanding performance at every aspect speaks than words.

The craft - Delicate braiding casing and solid material show elegant quality and allow the speaker to work smoothly dispite the environment around.

The light - 3-color RGB light controlled by the button at the bottom help create lively and dynamic atmosphere and warm your space.

Falling into Your Melody

More Power

Built-in microphone supports hands-free calls and conference meeting for your convenience, especially during this special time.

More Possibilities

Music enjoyment? Yes.

Workout partner? Yes.

Online courses? Yes.

Conference calls? Yes.

Outdoor companion? Absolutely yes.

Sound

Built-in 40mm driver delivers penetrating highs without aggression, crystal clear mids without muddiness, and strong bass without distortion.

Supply

With a rechargeable Li-ion battery inside to bring up to 8 hours playtime for your leisure hours, daily workout, hands-free calls, and outdoor activities.

Speed

To always keep up with the latest tech, SoundPEATS Halo is equipped with Bluetooth 5.0 to ensure fast and stable transmission within 33ft range.

Stereo

Support using two speakers simultanenously to provide you immersive experience and let the crisp and mellow voice massage your ears.
